Raven wandered the mortal world, bored with how mundane and dull humans had become over the centuries. One day, a new tech company caught her eye. Dynamic, bold, pushing the limits of science. The ambitious CEO leading it also intrigued him. A visionary yet humble human, dedicated to improving lives.

Raven decided to apply as an executive assistant, curious to see the inner workings of such an organization. To her surprise, he found the job and Boss quite enjoyable. The CEO was brilliant but often overworked, needing an assistant to handle details. Raven's magic allowed him to excel at the role.

Over time, Raven grew fond of her oblivious Boss. playing more and more lewd pranks though still keeping the CEO unaware. she was careful never to reveal the truth. It was a strange fondness for a human so briefly in her long life, yet Raven didn't question it. For now she was content serving her Boss and keeping magic hidden, wondering what mischief tomorrow may bring.
